changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO event_type (id,version,name,description,event_code,sort_order,active,date_created,last_updated) SELECT name,0,name,'Sidecar shipment audit event','CUSTOM',100,1,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM (SELECT 'AGENT_API_CHECKED' AS name UNION ALL SELECT 'AGENT_PORTAL_CHECKED' UNION ALL SELECT 'CHECK_SUCCESS' UNION ALL SELECT 'CARRIER_TRACKING_SYNCED' UNION ALL SELECT 'NEEDS_HUMAN_INTERVENTION' UNION ALL SELECT 'SIDECAR_WRITE') names WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM event_type e WHERE e.name=names.name AND e.event_code='CUSTOM');

changeSet.author: openai
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO event_type (id,version,name,description,event_code,sort_order,active,date_created,last_updated) SELECT name,0,name,'Shipment delivery update','CUSTOM',100,1,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM (SELECT 'Expected delivery date revised' AS name UNION ALL SELECT 'Delivery status confirmed' UNION ALL SELECT 'Delivery update requires review' UNION ALL SELECT 'Shipment note added') names WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM event_type e WHERE e.name=names.name AND e.event_code='CUSTOM');

changeSet.author: openai
changeSet.sql: UPDATE event e JOIN shipment_event se ON se.event_id=e.id JOIN shipment s ON s.id=se.shipment_events_id JOIN event_type et ON et.id=e.event_type_id SET e.event_type_id='Expected delivery date revised' WHERE s.shipment_number IN ('SHIP-2026-API1','SHIP-2026-WEB1') AND s.additional_information LIKE '%"synthetic":true%' AND et.name='CARRIER_TRACKING_SYNCED';

UPDATE event_log el JOIN event e ON e.id=el.event_id JOIN shipment_event se ON se.event_id=e.id JOIN shipment s ON s.id=se.shipment_events_id JOIN event_type et ON et.id=e.event_type_id SET el.message='Expected delivery date revised' WHERE s.shipment_number IN ('SHIP-2026-API1','SHIP-2026-WEB1') AND s.additional_information LIKE '%"synthetic":true%' AND et.name='Expected delivery date revised';

DELETE sel FROM shipment_event_log sel JOIN event_log el ON el.id=sel.event_log_id JOIN event e ON e.id=el.event_id JOIN event_type et ON et.id=e.event_type_id JOIN shipment s ON s.id=sel.shipment_id WHERE s.shipment_number IN ('SHIP-2026-API1','SHIP-2026-WEB1') AND s.additional_information LIKE '%"synthetic":true%' AND et.name IN ('AGENT_API_CHECKED','AGENT_PORTAL_CHECKED','CHECK_SUCCESS');

DELETE se FROM shipment_event se JOIN event e ON e.id=se.event_id JOIN event_type et ON et.id=e.event_type_id JOIN shipment s ON s.id=se.shipment_events_id WHERE s.shipment_number IN ('SHIP-2026-API1','SHIP-2026-WEB1') AND s.additional_information LIKE '%"synthetic":true%' AND et.name IN ('AGENT_API_CHECKED','AGENT_PORTAL_CHECKED','CHECK_SUCCESS');

UPDATE comment c JOIN shipment_comment sc ON sc.comment_id=c.id JOIN shipment s ON s.id=sc.shipment_comments_id SET c.comment=CASE s.shipment_number WHEN 'SHIP-2026-API1' THEN 'EasyPost reports a weather delay at Columbus, OH Terminal. Reason: Weather delay on I-70 East. Expected delivery changed from 20 Sep 2026, 00:00 UTC to 24 Sep 2026, 10:00 UTC.' WHEN 'SHIP-2026-WEB1' THEN 'LocalLTL reports a weather delay at Columbus, OH Terminal. Reason: Weather delay on I-70 East. Expected delivery changed from 21 Sep 2026, 00:00 UTC to 24 Sep 2026, 10:00 UTC.' ELSE c.comment END WHERE s.shipment_number IN ('SHIP-2026-API1','SHIP-2026-WEB1') AND s.additional_information LIKE '%"synthetic":true%' AND c.comment LIKE '%Sidecar Agent Report%';
